text:
Per-share merger consideration is a dual option: 20.200 Parent Shares (Stock Consideration) or $505.00 in cash (Cash Consideration) for each Company Share at the Titanium Merger Effective Time, with the mix governed by a Section 2.1(b) election framework; Dissenters have appraisal rights; No CVRs are provided.
Stock Consideration: 20.200 Parent Shares per Company Share; Cash Consideration: $505.00 per Company Share; Merger Fractional Share Payout: cash payable for fractional shares; Option Conversion Amount: the quotient obtained by dividing (a) the excess, if any, of (i) $505.00 minus (ii) the exercise price per Company Share applicable to such Company Option by (b) $25.00.
Per-Share Merger Consideration is fixed at 20.200 Parent Shares per Company Share or $505.00 in cash per Company Share, with stock or cash elections permitted under Section 2.1(b) and related proration (maximum cash election 45%, maximum stock election 55%), and cash-out for fractional shares under Section 2.5.
